codeReview.summary: Reviewed feature metadata, handoff, transcript skeleton, and commit 84d19e952c5ea6573af5222b3c5d47b4d13f2f91. Most provider-preservation behavior is implemented and well-tested, but xAI per-user model discovery has a cache-keying defect that can leak/cross-contaminate model catalogs between users.

issues.description: xAI model-capability caching is keyed only by endpoint token (`getXAIModelCapabilitiesCacheKey(tokenKey)` at lines 281-304/336), and `fetchModels` defaults that token to endpoint name (`tokenKey ?? name`, lines 532-537). In the per-user discovery path, `loadConfigModels` calls `fetchModels(...)` without a user-scoped `tokenKey` (api/server/services/Config/loadConfigModels.js:170-181), and this path is explicitly used with `includeUserProvidedFetch: true` in model listing (api/server/controllers/ModelController.js:342-347). Result: one user's xAI discovery can be served from another user's cached capabilities when they share the same endpoint name, violating expected per-user model state behavior.

summary: Fail. A blocking cache-keying bug in xAI model discovery can mix per-user model catalogs, so the feature does not fully satisfy the per-user discovery/state preservation requirement.
